blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: As dexterous robotic manipulation advances, scalable annotations of human hand-object interactions are becoming increasingly important. Furthermore, previous hand contact estimation methods suffered from issues such as dorsal-side misclassifications and insufficient precision, while lacking a unified framework for integrating multiple hand to environment interaction modalities, including distance fields, contact thresholds, and pressure. To address that, we present DenseHap, a unified end-to-end approach to estimate hand distance field recognition, comprehensive hand contact detection, hand pressure analysis, and hand reconstruction from a single monocular image. By incorporating three distinctly defined heads, along with a pretrained 3D reconstructed skeleton and an enhanced dataset, DenseHap outperforms previous state of the art models on four evaluation datasets, improving the F1 score by 8.5 percentage points (a 16% relative improvement) on untrained datasets and by 3 percentage points (5% relative improvement) on in-distribution datasets. Furthermore, DenseHap has effectively improved short-range hand estimate and pressure evaluation. Code and models will be publicly available upon the paper's acceptance.
blocks.zh: 随着可调和的机器人操纵的进步,可伸缩的人类手物相互作用说明变得越来越重要. 此外,以往的手接触估计方法存在诸如手侧分类错误和不够精确等问题,同时缺乏一个统一框架,将多手与环境互动模式相结合,包括距离领域、接触阈值和压力。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了DenseHap,一种统一的端到端方法,用来估计手相距场识别,全面的手相接触检测,手相压分析,以及手相重建从单一的单相相像. DenseHap在四个评价数据集上加入了三个明确定义的头,加上一个经过预先训练的3D重建骨架和一个增强的数据集,超越了以前的艺术模式,在未经过训练的数据集上提高了F1的8.5个百分点(相对改进了16%),在分配数据集上提高了3个百分点(相对改进了5%)。 此外,DenseHap还有效地改进了短距离手估计和压力评价。 守则和模型将在报章接受后公布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent dexterous manipulation systems [ 63 , 34 , 53 , 54 ] offer increasing proof that contact serves as an efficient medium for transmitting human demonstrations to robotic hands. Simultaneously, the acquisition of dexterous manipulation skills increasingly depends on human videos for guidance. Research such as DexMV [ 38 ] , VideoDex [ 42 ] , and DexVIP [ 31 ] illustrate the transformation of hand trajectories from these videos into robotic policies, underscoring the considerable opportunities presented by the abundant online resources of hands interacting with objects.
blocks.zh: 最近的狡猾操纵系统[63、34、53、54]提供了越来越多的证据,证明接触是将人类演示传递给机器人手的有效媒介。 同时,获取狡猾的操控技能越来越依赖于人类视频的指导。 DexMV[38],VideoDex[42],DexVIP[31]等研究说明了这些视频的手轨转化为机器人政策的情况,突出了手与物体互动的丰富在线资源所提供的大量机会.

blocks.en: However, these works typically concentrate on hand motion trajectories, while the primary factor that confers physical significance to manipulation, namely the point at which the hand makes contact with the world, is either disregarded or approximated post-hoc. This missing supervisory signal is precisely provided by dense hand contact. In this work, it is defined as the contact state at each vertex of the MANO mesh [ 39 ] , including point-wise distance fields, binary contact indicators, and force magnitudes. This signal grounds the reconstructed hand in the physical reality of its interactive behaviour. Therefore, as an explicit form of information, it provides direction for the subsequent disentanglement of hand motion representations and the fine-grained comprehension of manipulation details.
blocks.zh: 然而,这些作品通常集中于手动轨迹,而给操纵带来物理意义的主要因素,即手与世界接触的点,则要么被忽略,要么被近似于死后. 这种缺失的监管信号正是通过密集的手接触提供的. 在这项工作中,它被定义为MANO网格[39]的每个顶点的接触状态,包括点向的距离字段,二进制接触指标,和力度. 这个信号将重建的手放在其互动行为的实际现实中。 因此,作为一种明确的信息形式,它为随后手动表达的分散和对操纵细节的精细理解提供了方向。

blocks.en: In terms of efficiency, current approaches for dense contact estimation necessitate the use of a cascade of two independent models. Dense contact estimators, such as HACO [ 25 ] , predict per-vertex contact probabilities from cropped hand images but recover no geometry. Monocular hand reconstruction methods [ 35 , 37 , 8 , 44 ] recover MANO meshes accurately and at high throughput, but ignore contact. As a result, the estimator never views the mesh that its contact map is intended to annotate. In addition to requiring two inference passes, this separation allows for physically inconsistent predictions. For example, a fingertip placed at a significant distance from a surface that the estimator indicates as touched, without a mechanism to reconcile the two, renders the pipeline both unreliable and costly at the scale of millions of video frames. Moreover, hand contact is more fine-grained than full-body contact, often occurring in small regions such as the fingertips, which limits the effectiveness of conventional full-body contact estimators [ 25 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 就效率而言,目前进行密集接触估计的办法需要使用两个独立模型的连锁系统。 HACO [25] 等深层接触估计器,预测从被裁剪的手部图像中产生每个顶点接触概率,但没有恢复几何. 单体手部重建方法[35,37,8,44]以高吞吐量准确恢复MANO meshes,但忽略接触. 因此,估计者从不查看其联系图意在注释的网格. 除了需要两个推断证外,这种分离还允许物理上不一致的预测. 例如,一个指尖放置在与平面相距相当远的距离上,而估计者表示这种距离是触摸到的,没有调和两者的机制,使得管道不可靠,成本高达数百万个视频帧. 此外,手接触比全身接触更精细,经常发生在指尖等小区域,这限制了常规全身接触估计器的效果[25,7].

blocks.en: Motivated by these findings, we present DenseHap, an integrated framework that generates intricate per-vertex hand interaction data from a single RGB image in one forward pass, without the need for object templates or optimisation during testing. Three heads are connected to a WiLoR-based reconstruction backbone, with each head overseeing a shared visual representation. Furthermore, by employing the ViT backbone of WiLoR, a straightforward head allows for the effortless acquisition of 3D reconstruction results from identical features.
blocks.zh: 基于这些发现,我们提出了DenseHap,这是一个综合框架,它从一个前传的单个RGB图像中生成复杂的跨顶点手动交互数据,在测试过程中不需要对象模板或优化. 3个头与基于WiLOR的重建骨干相连,每个头监督一个共享的视觉表现. 此外,通过使用WiLOR的ViT主干线,一个直截了当的头部可以不费力地从相同的特性获得3D重建结果.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We introduce the first end-to-end framework that forecasts dense per-vertex interaction (distance, contact, pressure and reconstruction) and reconstructs 3D hand geometry from a single RGB image, utilising joint supervision over contact labels, spatial distance, and pressure signals. • Our approach attains cutting-edge dense contact precision, functioning at approximately double the throughput of current reconstruction-and-contact cascade systems, showcasing enhanced accuracy and efficiency. • We examine a collection of prior studies and perform a basic credibility assessment of these datasets on the contact dimension. Simultaneously, using the data sampling from the HACO data set, we developed an enhanced data cleaning procedure, resulting in a dataset that was double the size of the original.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献如下: 我们引入了第一个端到端框架,用于预测密集的顶点相互作用(距离、接触、压力和重建),并从单一的RGB图像中重建3D手几何,利用对接触标签、空间距离和压力信号的联合监督。 • 支助 我们的方法达到了尖端密集的接触精度,其运作大约是目前重建和接触级联系统的吞吐量的两倍,显示出精度和效率的提高。 我们审查以前研究的汇编,并对联系方面的数据集进行基本可信度评估。 同时,我们利用来自HACO数据集的数据取样,开发了一个强化的数据清理程序,形成了一个比原数据大一倍的数据集。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Hand Contact and Pressure Estimation. Early work on explicit hand-contact measurement relied on instrumented capture. ContactDB [ 3 ] uses thermal imaging to acquire object-surface contact maps after grasping, while ContactPose [ 4 ] associates these measurements with hand–object poses and RGB-D observations. At the image level, 100DOH [ 41 ] and ContactHands [ 33 ] detect hands and classify their contact states in Internet images, but do not localise contact on the hand surface. Dense 3D contact has also been used as an intermediate representation for physically plausible hand–object reconstruction. ContactOpt [ 13 ] optimises hand pose using predicted contact, while CPF [ 56 ] , TOCH [ 66 ] , S 2 Contact [ 49 ] , and UV-based reconstruction [ 59 ] model dense contact through geometric, temporal, semi-supervised, or UV-space representations. Beyond these reconstruction-oriented methods, POSA [ 19 ] learns pose-conditioned contact priors between the body and scene, while BSTRO [ 21 ] and DECO [ 48 ] infer dense vertex-level body contact from RGB images; their hand-region predictions provide relevant baselines. ContactPrompt [ 26 ] further performs training-free dense hand contact estimation through structured MLLM reasoning. Among supervised image-based approaches, HACO [ 25 ] is the closest general-purpose baseline to our setting. It predicts contact probabilities over the MANO vertices and explicitly addresses class and spatial imbalance. However, HACO treats contact estimation as a standalone task and does not recover input-specific 3D hand geometry, requiring a separate reconstruction network and thereby preventing shared feature learning while increasing the cost of large-scale image or video annotation.
Beyond binary contact, PressureVision [ 14 ] and PressureVision++ [ 15 ] estimate pressure from RGB images of interactions with instrumented planar surfaces, while EgoPressure [ 64 ] extends pressure estimation to egocentric views with hand-pose annotations. More recently, HOPE [ 24 ] predicts per-vertex contact and normal pressure from monocular video, and EgoPHI [ 23 ] estimates contact and 3D forces on hand and object meshes, but requires known object geometry. In contrast, our method jointly recovers input-specific hand geometry and dense surface contact from a single RGB image.

手接触与压力估计. 早期关于明确手接触测量的工作依赖于仪器捕获。 ContactDB [3] 使用热成像在抓取后获取物体表面接触图,ContactPose [4]将这些测量与手-物体的姿势和RGB-D观测联系起来. 在图像层面,100DOH[41]和ContactHands[33]在互联网图像中检测手和将其接触状态分类,但不将接触定位在手表面. Dense 3D接触也被用作物理上可行的手-物体重建的中间代表。 ContactOpt [13] 选择型手用预测型接触而摆出,而CPF [56],TOCH [66],S 2 Contact [49],以及基于紫外线的重建 [59] 模型密集接触通过几何,时间,半监督,或紫外线空间的表示. 除了这些面向重建的方法外,POSA [19] 学会了机体和场景之间摆设条件的接触前缀,而BSTRO [21] 和DECO [48] 推断出来自RGB图像的密集顶点层机体接触;他们的手区预测提供了相关的基线. ContactPrompt [26] 进一步通过结构化的MLLM推理来进行无训练的密集手接触估计. 在受监督的基于图像的方法中,HACO[25]是离我们设定最近的通用基线。 它预测在MANO顶点上的接触概率,并明确处理阶级和空间不平衡. 然而,HACO将接触估计作为一个独立的任务,不恢复输入专用的3D手几何,需要单独的重建网络,从而阻止共享特征学习,同时增加大规模图像或视频注释的成本.
除二进制接触外,压力视觉[14]和压力视觉++[15]估计来自RGB图像的与仪表板表面相互作用的压力,而EgoPressure[64]则将压力估计延伸到带有手持说明的自负式观点. 最近,HOPE [24] 预测了单视视频的每个顶点接触和正常压力,而EgoPHI [23] 估计手头的接触力和3D力以及对象网,但需要已知的物体几何. 相比之下,我们的方法共同从一个单一的RGB图像中恢复输入特定手几何和密集的表面接触.

blocks.en: Monocular 3D Hand Reconstruction The MANO parametric model [ 39 ] and increasingly powerful feed-forward architectures have accelerated the recovery of 3D hand geometry from single RGB images. Early systems such as FrankMocap [ 40 ] demonstrated practical monocular capture of hands and the full body, while transformer-based methods such as HaMeR [ 35 ] achieved robust in-the-wild hand mesh recovery through large-scale training and high-capacity backbones. WiLoR [ 37 ] further unifies hand localisation and reconstruction, providing the throughput and accuracy required to process unconstrained video at scale. These properties make modern reconstruction networks attractive for mining Internet video, enabling dynamic world-space reconstructions [ 62 , 60 ] and hand-object interactions [ 30 , 8 ] . However, they recover only geometry, leaving unmodeled the signals that distinguish manipulation from mere motion and indicate physical contact with the environment.
blocks.zh: 独家三维手重建 MANO参数模型[39]和日益强大的feed-forward架构加速了从单一RGB图像中恢复3D手几何. 弗兰克莫卡普[40]等早期系统展示了手部和全身的实用单体捕捉,而HaMeR[35]等变压器基方法通过大规模训练和高容量骨干实现了强力的手部网状恢复. WiLOR [37] 进一步统一手动本地化和重建,为大规模处理不受约束的视频提供所需的吞吐量和准确性. 这些属性使得现代重建网络对挖掘互联网视频具有吸引力,能够进行动态的世界空间重建[62,60]和手物交互[30,8]. 然而,它们只恢复几何,留下了未建模的信号来区分操纵和单纯的运动,并表明与环境的物理接触.

blocks.en: 3.1 Frozen Reconstruction Backbone
blocks.zh: 3.1 冻结重建后骨

blocks.en: We employ WiLoR as our frozen image encoder and reconstruction framework. The ViT-H/16 architecture [ 10 ] simultaneously analyses image tokens along with MANO-associated form, posture, and camera embeddings to yield hand-sensitive patch features, which are then decoded to recreate the 3D hand mesh. Our methodology employs two outputs from WiLoR: the reconstructed MANO vertices and the intermediate ViT feature map. The vertices provide explicit 3D geometric cues for contact reasoning, while the feature map serves as the visual representation for our prediction heads. Given that WiLoR is pre-trained explicitly for 3D hand reconstruction, its attributes are more congruent with hand-contact estimates compared to general semantic representations like DINOv3 [ 45 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们使用WiLOR作为我们冷冻的图像编码和重建框架. ViT-H/16架构[10]同时分析图像符号与MANO关联的形态,姿态,和相机嵌入以产生手感的补丁特性,然后解码以重新创建3D手网. 我们的方法利用了WiLOR的两个产出:重建后的MANO顶点和中间的ViT特征图. 顶点为接触推理提供了明确的3D几何提示,而特征图则作为我们预测头的视觉表现. 鉴于WiLOR是专门为3D手重建进行预训的,其属性与手接触估计值相比,与DINOv3[45]等一般语义表示值相比更为一致.

blocks.en: Although we train three heads, the final output can be derived directly from either the distance-threshold head or the contact head. On most datasets, the distance-threshold head performs better. The contact head outperforms it only when training data for the target dataset are unavailable or when the test annotations are human-labelled and widely dispersed. We therefore adopt the distance-threshold head as our default model. Nevertheless, the contact head remains important: it plays a mediating role that benefits semantic segmentation and performs well on datasets with subjective annotations.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们训练了三个头,但最终的输出可以直接从距离阈值头或接触头得到. 在大多数数据集中,距离阈值头表现较好. 只有在没有目标数据集的培训数据或测试说明被人类贴上标签并广泛分散时,接触头才会超越它。 因此,我们采用距离门槛头作为我们的默认模式。 尽管如此,联系人头仍然很重要:它发挥调解作用,有利于语义分割,并在带有主观说明的数据集上表现良好.

blocks.en: 4.1 Hand Contact Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 手接触数据集

blocks.en: Table 1 : Dataset audit details 18 retained datasets, including their share of the training pool and primary interaction types. It also lists excluded datasets with reasons for their omission. ContactPose and EPIC-Contact (bottom block) are held out for evaluation.

blocks.en: The estimation of dense hand contact is an emerging area of research, with this study offering a significant contribution through a comprehensive review of publicly available hand-contact datasets up to July 2026. The framework assesses 30 datasets, encompassing around 4 million samples, and amalgamates 18 that meet stringent quality-control standards into a unified training corpus containing 1.16 million samples. The ten excluded datasets failed due to various issues, such as inconsistent or misaligned contact annotations (notably GigaHands, EgoPressure, and HOT3D), domain disparity with bare-hand–object interactions (EgoTouch, InterHand2.6M, and HIC), and absence of real-world imagery (GRAB). To promote reproducibility, the detailed audit is published to assist future researchers in avoiding the burdensome process of dataset screening.
blocks.zh: 密集手接触的估计是一个新兴的研究领域,这项研究通过全面审查截至2026年7月的公开手接触数据集,做出了重大贡献。 该框架评估了30个数据集,包括大约400万个样本,并将18个符合严格质量控制标准的数据集合并成一个包含116万个样本的统一培训材料。 由于各种问题,例如联系说明不一致或不一致(特别是GigaHands、EgoPressure和HOT3D),与光手对象相互作用(EgoTouch、InterHand2.6M和HIC)的域差,以及缺乏现实世界的图像(GRAB)。 为了促进可复制性,公布了详细的审计,以协助未来的研究人员避免数据集筛选的繁琐过程。

blocks.en: The study identifies three primary sources of contact labels that shape the design of the corpus. The first source involves geometric determination through thresholding the distance between hand vertices and the object surface, as seen in datasets like ObMan [ 20 ] and DexYCB [ 6 ] , which were initially created for hand–object reconstruction. The second method includes direct measurements or annotations, such as thermal imprinting in ContactPose and manual labeling, along with pseudo-ground-truths derived via multiple view optimization in Decaf [ 43 ] . The third source consists of automated propagation of human-annotated contact labels through pipelines, exemplified by MOW [ 5 ] and EPIC [ 2 ] Contact. Historically, contact estimation has been tied to reconstruction tasks, leading to the prevalence of geometrically derived labels in existing datasets and the current corpus.
blocks.zh: 研究确定了塑造本体设计的三大联系标签来源. 第一个来源涉及通过对手顶点与物体表面之间的距离的阈值来进行几何测定,如ObMan [20]和DexYCB [6]等数据集所见,这些数据集最初是为手-物体重建而创建的. 第二种方法包括直接测量或说明,如ContactPose中的热印记和手动标签,以及无咖啡因中通过多视图优化产生的伪地面真伪[43]. 第三个来源是通过管道自动传播人类附加说明的接触标签,以MOW[5]和EPIC[2]接触为例。 历史上,联系估计一直与重建任务挂钩,导致现有数据集和当前实体中几何衍生标签的普及.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Unified threshold measurement
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 统一阈值计量

blocks.en: To assess progress while limiting MOW’s format bias, we use the two datasets with the most accurate annotations as our primary test sets: EPIC-Contact [ 2 ] , the latest dataset for contact estimation, and ContactPose [ 4 ] , which provides accurate contact labels from thermal imprints. Neither HACO nor DenseHap was trained on these datasets, enabling a fair zero-shot comparison. For in-distribution evaluation, we retain MOW from HACO’s original evaluation framework and add ARCTIC [ 11 ] , which provides relatively accurate contact annotations. We exclude HIC [ 50 ] and Hi4D [ 58 ] from main evaluation because they focus primarily on hand-to-hand and hand-to-body interactions, which fall outside our evaluation scope.
blocks.zh: 为了评估进展,同时限制MOW格式偏差,我们使用两个最精确说明的数据集作为我们的主要测试集:EPIC-Contact [2],用于联系估计的最新数据集,以及ContactPose [4],它提供了来自热印的准确联系标签. 无论是HACO还是DENSEHap都没有接受过有关这些数据集的培训,从而能够进行公平的零镜头比较. 对于分布式评价,我们保留了HACO最初的评价框架的MOW,并增加了ACTIC [11],提供了相对准确的联系说明. 我们把HIC[50]和Hi4D[58]排除在主要评价之外,因为它们主要侧重于亲手和亲身互动,这不属于我们的评价范围。

blocks.en: Table 2 summarizes the results. DenseHap outperforms HACO on all four datasets, with the largest gains on the most accurately annotated benchmarks. Under zero-shot evaluation, F1 improves by 8.5 points (+14.5% relative) on thermally measured ContactPose and by 8.3 points (+19.4%) on EPIC-Contact. The in-distribution gains on MOW (+3.3 points) and ARCTIC (+2.1 points) are smaller but consistent. The stronger performance on unseen benchmarks indicates estimation quality rather than overfitting to a particular label distribution.

blocks.en: Furthermore, DenseHap(distance head) enhances both aspects of predictive efficacy: mean recall escalates from .667 .667 to .788 .788 , while mean precision advances from .498 .498 to .542 .542 . The largest precision gain occurs on ARCTIC, from .516 .516 to .675 .675 . MOW illustrates the caveat discussed earlier: DenseHap achieves near-complete recall ( .926 .926 ) but low precision ( .432 .432 ), because matching MOW’s exaggerated labels requires predicting contact well beyond the true touch region. This setting favors broad predictions and penalizes precise ones. We therefore treat MOW as a historical benchmark rather than a primary measure of contact quality.
blocks.zh: 此外,DenseHap(远程头)提高了预测效果的两个方面:平均召回率从667.667升至788.788,而平均精确率从498.498升至542.542。 最大的精度增益发生在ACTIC上,从516 516到675 675. DenseHap实现近乎完全的召回(926,926),但精度低(432,432), 因为匹配MOW夸张的标签要求预测接触远远超出真正的触摸区域。 这种设定有利于广义的预测,惩罚准确的预测。 因此,我们把妇女事务部视为一个历史基准,而不是衡量接触质量的主要标准。

blocks.en: Figure 3 illustrates examples generated by several models. The contact estimation for models such as BSTRO and DECO appears to be relatively imprecise. HACO enhances performance, although it frequently applies a rudimentary colouration to both sides of the hand without differentiating between the palm and the dorsal side. blocks.en: The results favor architectures that aggregate global information over independent local prediction. Projecting each hand vertex onto backbone features and predicting contact from a local patch is insufficient because contact states are spatially correlated across vertices and local evidence is ambiguous under occlusion. Global cues such as object geometry, scale, and interaction type are needed to distinguish narrow contacts, such as grasping a pencil, from broad planar contacts, such as touching a table. Cross-attention addresses these limitations by retrieving vertex-specific evidence from a global representation.
blocks.zh: 结果倾向于将全球信息综合起来的结构,而不是独立的局部预测。 将每个手顶点投射到骨干特征上,并预测从局部补丁接触,是不够的,因为接触状态在空间上与顶点相关,在隔离下,局部证据模糊不清. 需要诸如对象几何,尺度,和相互作用类型等全局提示来区分诸如抓住铅笔等狭小的接触与诸如触摸桌子等广义的平面接触. 交叉关注通过从全球代表处获取特定顶点证据来解决这些局限性。

blocks.en: The best per-vertex model achieves a mean F1 score of 0.435, while global-vector decoding and learned queries yield scores of 0.546 and 0.538, respectively. The one-token cross-attention variant scores 0.533, surpassing several methods including max pooling and CLS-based self-attention. Performance is influenced by dataset composition, sampling, and augmentation, with up to five F1 point variations within the same model family. The 14-dataset model excels on HIC and RICH, while corrected square-root sampling with augmentation performs best on MOW and Hi4D. Effective contact estimation requires global decoding and adaptable training strategies to manage variations in interactions and dataset bias.

blocks.en: We also evaluate model efficiency. Running WiLoR and HACO independently introduces redundant computation, as both rely on large backbones to encode the same image (Table 9 ). DenseHap avoids this redundancy by sharing a single visual representation across reconstruction and interaction reasoning, providing a better balance between throughput and functionality than the cascaded system.
blocks.zh: 我们还评估模型效率。 运行WiLOR和HACO独立地引入了冗余计算,因为两者都依赖大型骨干编码相同的图像(表9 ). DenseHap通过在重建与互动推理之间共享单一的视觉表现来避免这种冗余,在吞吐量与功能之间提供了比级联系统更好的平衡.

blocks.en: Most of DenseHap’s overhead comes from a lightweight task-specific head rather than a second image encoder. It retains efficient reconstruction-only inference while additionally predicting contact, distance, and pressure. Consequently, DenseHap is 1.7× faster than the WiLoR, HACO cascade, making it suited for large-scale video annotation.
blocks.zh: DenseHap的间接费用大多来自轻量级任务特定头而不是第二个图像编码器. 它保留了高效的仅用于重建的推论,同时额外预测接触、距离和压力。 因此,DenseHap比WiLOR,HACO级联快1.7×,使其适合大型视频注释.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en: In conclusion, we have developed DenseHap, a comprehensive framework that, in a single forward pass, provides a detailed per-vertex contact, distance, and 3D hand mesh from a single RGB image. After constructing a clean dataset from 28 relevant datasets, we integrated three parameter-independent vertex-query cross-attention trunks into a static WiLoR backbone and trained them using a multiple loss function design to address class imbalance. Our model achieves a throughput of approximately 1.7 × \times that of a reconstruction-contact cascade and improves the F1 score by approximately 10% compared to the current state of the art across zero-shot datasets.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们开发了DenseHap这一综合框架,在一个单一的前进通道中,从一个单一的RGB图像中提供详细的每个顶点接触,距离,和3D手网. 在从28个相关数据集构建一个干净的数据集后,我们把3个参数独立的顶点-清水交叉切换干线整合到一个静态的WiLOR主干线中,并用多重损失函数设计对其进行培训,以解决阶级失衡问题. 我们的模型实现了大约1.7xxx次的吞吐量 重建-接触级联的吞吐量, 与目前零射数据集相比, F1 的得分提高了约10%。

blocks.en: Limitations. Despite the performance improvements, our method still suffers from some limitations. Firstly, the model performance can be highly affected under the presence of severe occlusions. In addition, given that our main objective is to predict hand object contact and pressure, our model is not tailored for hand-hand and hand-body interactions. Nevertheless, both limitations could be easily addressed with the use of additional datasets that include heavier occlusions and hand-body interactions.
blocks.zh: 限制。 尽管业绩有所改善,但我们的方法仍然受到一些限制。 首先,模型性能在存在严重堵塞的情况下会受到严重影响. 此外,鉴于我们的主要目标是预测手物体接触和压力,我们的模型并不是针对手和手的身体相互作用而设计的. 然而,通过使用额外数据集,包括较重的隔离和手部相互作用,可以很容易地解决这两种局限性。
